rows.question: I joined four years ago. How many days of annual leave am I entitled to?
rows.rewritten: How many days of annual leave are entitled to an employee who has been with the company for four years?
rows.answer: 1. Since the employee has less than 5 years of service, they are entitled to 16 days of paid annual leave per calendar year [POL-02 §1.1].

problems: The answer incorrectly states that the employee is entitled to 16 days of paid annual leave, when according to the clauses, they should receive fewer days due to their service period.

rows.question: A client sent me a gift worth RM 250. Do I need to do anything?
rows.rewritten: Is it necessary to report a gift valued at RM 250 received from a client?
rows.answer: Yes, you need to declare the gift to Compliance within 7 days [POL-08 §2.2].

rows.question: A supplier gave me a RM 150 pen set. Can I keep it?
rows.rewritten: Is it permissible to retain a RM 150 pen set received from a supplier?
rows.answer: Yes, you can keep it as it is worth up to RM 200 and meets the cap of RM 150 set by POL-08 §3.1 and POL-04 §3.3.

rows.question: My expense claim is RM 9,000. Who approves it?
rows.rewritten: Who approves expense claims exceeding RM 9,000?
rows.answer: A claim of RM 9,000 is approved by the department head [POL-04 §2.2].

rows.question: I am flying 7 hours to Sydney for work. Can I upgrade to premium economy?
rows.rewritten: Am I eligible for premium economy upgrade coverage for a 7-hour flight to Sydney for business purposes?
rows.answer: Yes, you can upgrade to premium economy or business class as your flight is 7 hours or more, and you are at Director level or above [POL-05 §2.2].

rows.question: do i need a doctor's note if i'm only off sick for one day
rows.rewritten: Do I require a medical certificate (mc) for a one-day sick leave (sl)?
rows.answer: No, you do not need a doctor's note for a 1-day sick leave as it does not meet the requirement of 2 or more consecutive days [POL-02 §3.3].

rows.question: if i resign do i get paid for the leave i havent used
rows.rewritten: upon resignation, am i entitled to payment for unused leave balances?
rows.answer: Yes, accrued but untaken leave is paid out at the basic daily rate upon termination of employment [POL-02 §1.5].

rows.question: my wife just gave birth, how long do i have to take paternity leave
rows.rewritten: how long is the entitlement for paternity leave after the birth of a child
rows.answer: You have 7 working days for paternity leave, and it must be taken within 60 days of the birth [POL-02 §4.2].

rows.question: how much notice for taking just one day off next week
rows.rewritten: what is the required notice period for taking a one-day leave next week
rows.answer: Yes, 3 working days notice is required for leave of 3 working days or fewer [POL-02 §2.1].

rows.question: Does the company offer free counselling, and how many sessions do I get?
rows.rewritten: Are mental health counselling services provided, and what is the entitlement for session(s)?
rows.answer: Yes, the company offers free counselling through the Employee Assistance Programme [POL-13 §3.2]. You get up to 6 sessions per issue per year.

rows.question: got a weird email asking me to click a link, what do i do
rows.rewritten: What is the appropriate action if you receive a suspicious email containing a link?
rows.answer:
1. Report the suspected phishing email using the report button in your email client [POL-06 §5.1].
2. Immediately report the incident to security@meridianworks.example [POL-06 §5.2].

rows.question: Can I read my work email on my personal phone?
rows.rewritten: Is it permissible to access work email on a personal mobile device?
rows.answer: Yes, but your personal device must be enrolled in the mobile device management system [POL-06 §2.2].

rows.question: How long does the company keep CCTV recordings?
rows.rewritten: What is the company policy regarding the retention period of CCTV recordings?
rows.answer: CCTV footage is kept for 30 days unless needed for an investigation [POL-07 §3.4].

rows.question: What is the daily meal allowance for an overseas trip to a Tier 1 city?
rows.rewritten: What is the daily meal allowance for an overseas trip to a Tier 1 city according to the company policy handbook?
rows.answer: Yes, the daily meal allowance for an overseas trip to a Tier 1 city is RM 180 per day [POL-05 §3.1].

rows.question: One of my team members was rated 2 in the review. What happens next?
rows.rewritten: What is the process following a performance rating of 2 in the review cycle?
rows.answer:
1. The employee will be placed on a performance improvement plan (PIP) for 60 days [POL-09 §4.1].
2. The manager and employee must meet at least every 2 weeks during the PIP [POL-09 §4.2].
3. The employee is not eligible for promotion or the annual bonus under POL-10 during the PIP [POL-09 §4.3].

rows.question: What is the long service award for 10 years of service?
rows.rewritten: What is the long service award for a tenure of 10 years as per the company policy handbook?
rows.answer: The long service award for 10 years of service is RM 2,500 [POL-10 §3.2].

rows.question: How many quotations do we need for a RM 60,000 purchase?
rows.rewritten: How many quotations are required for a RM 60,000 purchase according to the company policy handbook?
rows.answer: A RM 60,000 purchase requires a formal tender and approval from both the CFO and the CEO [POL-12 §1.3].

rows.question: How much notice does someone on probation have to give?
rows.rewritten: What is the required notice period for an employee on probation?
rows.answer: 1 month [POL-11 §3.2].

rows.question: What is the daily food allowance for a business trip within Malaysia?
rows.rewritten: What is the daily per diem allowance for a business trip within Malaysia according to company policy?
rows.answer: Domestic meal allowance during business travel is RM 70 per day [POL-05 §3.2].
